**Hangxiety** is ` [Highlight start] the intense feeling of anxiety, dread, guilt, or unease that can happen after drinking alcohol, often alongside or in place of a typical hangover [Highlight end] ` . It can start within hours of drinking or peak the morning after.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXHCQemkDOAhZ4cBL014dRpkjtC2QyoA7DwZjyKjrlyXtWBd1KoFMPRamyp0l0jMhCkIsVGpIJV0dXdevKcOgNUcK5foPwkpcGru2N-u4d7WUwC2ycOsdAc7O32kGPIuSgvNxwrXlw_NZZzo_Nghyb3Jip6NQIVg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXCrMmlHcUJ-Ilu4iMQ4IK1D5b74PX8gvkx28S7zqMp1wW8t2tEKZgWoec4ZaPDbkUVZntuuzyxee-zzjvhx4LQ_aKRVcu5LbMKECbK_Ao9taYBm-1sf-cu1e7GJxDT-YKKz-OxTnuwyVZvMDr7nj6hun4ShqH1PvOkNA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXiz6ciIbDk8IlyLdwVAfLRxOI6EoEhE7l0XcmYa7PH7vFlqosCkItI673pUteWJQ7eeuDTKpd-OrHf1-yD61WwFMTmahrIPBq_WY0YY353RIuCqF__xLf7jlTVRrcudVMFWgzlGlDhEay10qu38At__pySB370ns)

### Symptoms

- **Emotional:** Dread, nervousness, irritability, sadness, or a sense of impending doom.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF1ypg7jsFm8FJTpb_VZGT0hP0Y3b_Tl3yJeHBbreaScFrEBiw65vTeH3TGlGXMFT-j873pjZAi1anTbX-Qz_dLp_ZBsXl8qc-ykMyIGqVjMYjFJp0vMGV4t3K6KO598Me69V5iOyGtulWzZMKg5KzzDfwgTJuWhdDVGTekcWiLtU_4N1jzI5_sA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXHCQemkDOAhZ4cBL014dRpkjtC2QyoA7DwZjyKjrlyXtWBd1KoFMPRamyp0l0jMhCkIsVGpIJV0dXdevKcOgNUcK5foPwkpcGru2N-u4d7WUwC2ycOsdAc7O32kGPIuSgvNxwrXlw_NZZzo_Nghyb3Jip6NQIVg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXTrZ8XHJxZu5AeEbVj-pog8viF0-Gm7w0GYnycqqqnC9vgExELclrmIifs4WGcj2AGWH6aXbYqlpr6v1zLaBwU0kyNEfea8woTie-pxQXdKTlQf22MmO7-8oQ4WKZ7yrb1nrGIsLX)
- **Social & cognitive:** Regret, embarrassment, replaying conversations, worrying about what you said or did, or brain fog.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17eLYxVez1lanRbbQpsAOlqxMkNhHTI2p9OaF18sHsIHrbxbAO8c1EqyVtgKBQqo3Iuq8gwmhB7sc9KPzaGV5yHqKfqyaDA8rhrGH8--wpHx-XMlf3fbcn4r4n-j5RlRCny0jedmD99D5x6mFZhrU2zeLLvFgr4JUEZyT_lXkjslVzIO)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXHCQemkDOAhZ4cBL014dRpkjtC2QyoA7DwZjyKjrlyXtWBd1KoFMPRamyp0l0jMhCkIsVGpIJV0dXdevKcOgNUcK5foPwkpcGru2N-u4d7WUwC2ycOsdAc7O32kGPIuSgvNxwrXlw_NZZzo_Nghyb3Jip6NQIVg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXTrZ8XHJxZu5AeEbVj-pog8viF0-Gm7w0GYnycqqqnC9vgExELclrmIifs4WGcj2AGWH6aXbYqlpr6v1zLaBwU0kyNEfea8woTie-pxQXdKTlQf22MmO7-8oQ4WKZ7yrb1nrGIsLX)
- **Physical:** Racing or pounding heart, sweating, shakiness, butterflies in the stomach, restlessness, or nausea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX0gUS8CDL7TD4lXt4bh7pqF6cLXPUJQOPNHTExUHenQBb1c4mVnGU7ySogoV-kdlXPBxzFIOABliJCVrKPckhgaqU4xrERqtM_KIwKgnu38s9aI7zDAnfVT07yLzV851_34PUKLg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXCrMmlHcUJ-Ilu4iMQ4IK1D5b74PX8gvkx28S7zqMp1wW8t2tEKZgWoec4ZaPDbkUVZntuuzyxee-zzjvhx4LQ_aKRVcu5LbMKECbK_Ao9taYBm-1sf-cu1e7GJxDT-YKKz-OxTnuwyVZvMDr7nj6hun4ShqH1PvOkNA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESygEBxCJF18lc9cjtVrlL7f3wH1yE9iy8sFI7DmylIaXlr_cK8vTwYBr7r4bLxbBWSLvyYY37LriJ_DuYK1YpamWXN4VRi5FwdEXuwPEj6aqgi0lUmye9FWA52kqwzAIvHcgJwjOKlU2aAt8ZhviRoLZpowq6jb2RYlPBnD5q6FEitNslFNyvJq0B37cOopk0oaxYxuzKA_osaIak3RIP6hO_3aZ5Nj5I6a1IX4c90ZWX94VTQwF7AnTWhk1NtH5O7Ji4F56lWmlujjc2)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXTrZ8XHJxZu5AeEbVj-pog8viF0-Gm7w0GYnycqqqnC9vgExELclrmIifs4WGcj2AGWH6aXbYqlpr6v1zLaBwU0kyNEfea8woTie-pxQXdKTlQf22MmO7-8oQ4WKZ7yrb1nrGIsLX)

### What Causes It

- **Brain chemistry rebound:** Alcohol boosts calming GABA and dampens activating glutamate while you drink, then reverses as your body clears it—leaving you more wired and anxious. Dopamine and serotonin drops can also add to the low mood.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXX279TqswZn5DAcUJxMIxrXpiE8EgHvLao_nkb-1mmAATm7wFfQvbXVG5oyIc7zXe7mhf3v5aTmlHWSfdKroloX751k6o1dD15XrESwtO4l46Dx8J_ARbw7ruPKpbGw9oDnSSJsA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF1ypg7jsFm8FJTpb_VZGT0hP0Y3b_Tl3yJeHBbreaScFrEBiw65vTeH3TGlGXMFT-j873pjZAi1anTbX-Qz_dLp_ZBsXl8qc-ykMyIGqVjMYjFJp0vMGV4t3K6KO598Me69V5iOyGtulWzZMKg5KzzDfwgTJuWhdDVGTekcWiLtU_4N1jzI5_sA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESygEBxCJF18lc9cjtVrlL7f3wH1yE9iy8sFI7DmylIaXlr_cK8vTwYBr7r4bLxbBWSLvyYY37LriJ_DuYK1YpamWXN4VRi5FwdEXuwPEj6aqgi0lUmye9FWA52kqwzAIvHcgJwjOKlU2aAt8ZhviRoLZpowq6jb2RYlPBnD5q6FEitNslFNyvJq0B37cOopk0oaxYxuzKA_osaIak3RIP6hO_3aZ5Nj5I6a1IX4c90ZWX94VTQwF7AnTWhk1NtH5O7Ji4F56lWmlujjc2)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17eLYxVez1lanRbbQpsAOlqxMkNhHTI2p9OaF18sHsIHrbxbAO8c1EqyVtgKBQqo3Iuq8gwmhB7sc9KPzaGV5yHqKfqyaDA8rhrGH8--wpHx-XMlf3fbcn4r4n-j5RlRCny0jedmD99D5x6mFZhrU2zeLLvFgr4JUEZyT_lXkjslVzIO)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1410JuzbXYTWn_0_rIGyXon7pGrDKUBwPo5lCXExrcCc7KrRRDNmeCH-xfiPzsf7dTT9DrUeEdAg6PvXncQlCHTGxxD9Zg5BK6JS2JBRUZKLqgxW1kg5jYGgtxVAtwkW4kOOfEQIQdmFrQfW7_Na9LGtbD6R0ezOr6XNbzhY9IIHF8A)
- **Poor sleep & dehydration:** Alcohol disrupts restorative REM sleep and causes dehydration, which lowers emotional resilience and mimics anxiety symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXiz6ciIbDk8IlyLdwVAfLRxOI6EoEhE7l0XcmYa7PH7vFlqosCkItI673pUteWJQ7eeuDTKpd-OrHf1-yD61WwFMTmahrIPBq_WY0YY353RIuCqF__xLf7jlTVRrcudVMFWgzlGlDhEay10qu38At__pySB370ns)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESygEBxCJF18lc9cjtVrlL7f3wH1yE9iy8sFI7DmylIaXlr_cK8vTwYBr7r4bLxbBWSLvyYY37LriJ_DuYK1YpamWXN4VRi5FwdEXuwPEj6aqgi0lUmye9FWA52kqwzAIvHcgJwjOKlU2aAt8ZhviRoLZpowq6jb2RYlPBnD5q6FEitNslFNyvJq0B37cOopk0oaxYxuzKA_osaIak3RIP6hO_3aZ5Nj5I6a1IX4c90ZWX94VTQwF7AnTWhk1NtH5O7Ji4F56lWmlujjc2)
- **Psychological & social factors:** Worry over impaired judgment or awkward moments can fuel rumination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXyrXNXBwcIqUGvtCpjxPQMEZeo654iqoCDX-Ic_8S9TWdprN0rebFn0gQ3LoYrGeauJnef7z4rharxGzWNUUoFgmPWtrjXiRxy_fLzsPd_NP8Gq7YrZrEPAeVomN4gGnByNYY5w7kqOg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17eLYxVez1lanRbbQpsAOlqxMkNhHTI2p9OaF18sHsIHrbxbAO8c1EqyVtgKBQqo3Iuq8gwmhB7sc9KPzaGV5yHqKfqyaDA8rhrGH8--wpHx-XMlf3fbcn4r4n-j5RlRCny0jedmD99D5x6mFZhrU2zeLLvFgr4JUEZyT_lXkjslVzIO)

### How Long It Lasts
For most people, hangxiety is strongest the day after drinking and fades within 24 hours. Drinking more alcohol to ease it often prolongs the cycle, while anxiety lasting several days can point to stronger withdrawal or an underlying mental health issue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXHCQemkDOAhZ4cBL014dRpkjtC2QyoA7DwZjyKjrlyXtWBd1KoFMPRamyp0l0jMhCkIsVGpIJV0dXdevKcOgNUcK5foPwkpcGru2N-u4d7WUwC2ycOsdAc7O32kGPIuSgvNxwrXlw_NZZzo_Nghyb3Jip6NQIVg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXiz6ciIbDk8IlyLdwVAfLRxOI6EoEhE7l0XcmYa7PH7vFlqosCkItI673pUteWJQ7eeuDTKpd-OrHf1-yD61WwFMTmahrIPBq_WY0YY353RIuCqF__xLf7jlTVRrcudVMFWgzlGlDhEay10qu38At__pySB370ns)

### Who Is More Prone
Anyone can get hangxiety, but it is more common in people who already experience anxiety, depression, trauma, or high stress. Shy or introverted individuals, heavy or binge drinkers, and people who drink to cope with social anxiety are also more susceptible.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXHCQemkDOAhZ4cBL014dRpkjtC2QyoA7DwZjyKjrlyXtWBd1KoFMPRamyp0l0jMhCkIsVGpIJV0dXdevKcOgNUcK5foPwkpcGru2N-u4d7WUwC2ycOsdAc7O32kGPIuSgvNxwrXlw_NZZzo_Nghyb3Jip6NQIVg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXiz6ciIbDk8IlyLdwVAfLRxOI6EoEhE7l0XcmYa7PH7vFlqosCkItI673pUteWJQ7eeuDTKpd-OrHf1-yD61WwFMTmahrIPBq_WY0YY353RIuCqF__xLf7jlTVRrcudVMFWgzlGlDhEay10qu38At__pySB370ns)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17eLYxVez1lanRbbQpsAOlqxMkNhHTI2p9OaF18sHsIHrbxbAO8c1EqyVtgKBQqo3Iuq8gwmhB7sc9KPzaGV5yHqKfqyaDA8rhrGH8--wpHx-XMlf3fbcn4r4n-j5RlRCny0jedmD99D5x6mFZhrU2zeLLvFgr4JUEZyT_lXkjslVzIO)

### Coping & Prevention

- **Right now:** Rehydrate with water or electrolytes, eat light food, rest, and distract yourself with calm activities or mindfulness. Skip extra alcohol and limit caffeine, which can worsen jitters. For more guidance on calming symptoms, see [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXHCQemkDOAhZ4cBL014dRpkjtC2QyoA7DwZjyKjrlyXtWBd1KoFMPRamyp0l0jMhCkIsVGpIJV0dXdevKcOgNUcK5foPwkpcGru2N-u4d7WUwC2ycOsdAc7O32kGPIuSgvNxwrXlw_NZZzo_Nghyb3Jip6NQIVg) or [Lemonaid Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXCrMmlHcUJ-Ilu4iMQ4IK1D5b74PX8gvkx28S7zqMp1wW8t2tEKZgWoec4ZaPDbkUVZntuuzyxee-zzjvhx4LQ_aKRVcu5LbMKECbK_Ao9taYBm-1sf-cu1e7GJxDT-YKKz-OxTnuwyVZvMDr7nj6hun4ShqH1PvOkNA).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXX279TqswZn5DAcUJxMIxrXpiE8EgHvLao_nkb-1mmAATm7wFfQvbXVG5oyIc7zXe7mhf3v5aTmlHWSfdKroloX751k6o1dD15XrESwtO4l46Dx8J_ARbw7ruPKpbGw9oDnSSJsA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXyrXNXBwcIqUGvtCpjxPQMEZeo654iqoCDX-Ic_8S9TWdprN0rebFn0gQ3LoYrGeauJnef7z4rharxGzWNUUoFgmPWtrjXiRxy_fLzsPd_NP8Gq7YrZrEPAeVomN4gGnByNYY5w7kqOg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXiz6ciIbDk8IlyLdwVAfLRxOI6EoEhE7l0XcmYa7PH7vFlqosCkItI673pUteWJQ7eeuDTKpd-OrHf1-yD61WwFMTmahrIPBq_WY0YY353RIuCqF__xLf7jlTVRrcudVMFWgzlGlDhEay10qu38At__pySB370ns)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXHCQemkDOAhZ4cBL014dRpkjtC2QyoA7DwZjyKjrlyXtWBd1KoFMPRamyp0l0jMhCkIsVGpIJV0dXdevKcOgNUcK5foPwkpcGru2N-u4d7WUwC2ycOsdAc7O32kGPIuSgvNxwrXlw_NZZzo_Nghyb3Jip6NQIVg)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXCrMmlHcUJ-Ilu4iMQ4IK1D5b74PX8gvkx28S7zqMp1wW8t2tEKZgWoec4ZaPDbkUVZntuuzyxee-zzjvhx4LQ_aKRVcu5LbMKECbK_Ao9taYBm-1sf-cu1e7GJxDT-YKKz-OxTnuwyVZvMDr7nj6hun4ShqH1PvOkNA)
- **Next time:** Eat before drinking, pace yourself, alternate drinks with water, set a drink limit, or drink less—and consider talking with a healthcare provider if hangxiety is frequent or tied to relying on alcohol to cope.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXyrXNXBwcIqUGvtCpjxPQMEZeo654iqoCDX-Ic_8S9TWdprN0rebFn0gQ3LoYrGeauJnef7z4rharxGzWNUUoFgmPWtrjXiRxy_fLzsPd_NP8Gq7YrZrEPAeVomN4gGnByNYY5w7kqOg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF1ypg7jsFm8FJTpb_VZGT0hP0Y3b_Tl3yJeHBbreaScFrEBiw65vTeH3TGlGXMFT-j873pjZAi1anTbX-Qz_dLp_ZBsXl8qc-ykMyIGqVjMYjFJp0vMGV4t3K6KO598Me69V5iOyGtulWzZMKg5KzzDfwgTJuWhdDVGTekcWiLtU_4N1jzI5_sA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXiz6ciIbDk8IlyLdwVAfLRxOI6EoEhE7l0XcmYa7PH7vFlqosCkItI673pUteWJQ7eeuDTKpd-OrHf1-yD61WwFMTmahrIPBq_WY0YY353RIuCqF__xLf7jlTVRrcudVMFWgzlGlDhEay10qu38At__pySB370ns)

### Frequent Hangxiety
Frequent hangxiety can signal that alcohol is worsening underlying anxiety or mood issues, or that your body is reacting to regular rebound effects. Using alcohol to manage anxiety can create a repetitive cycle; cutting back or speaking with a doctor or therapist can help clarify what is driving it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXCrMmlHcUJ-Ilu4iMQ4IK1D5b74PX8gvkx28S7zqMp1wW8t2tEKZgWoec4ZaPDbkUVZntuuzyxee-zzjvhx4LQ_aKRVcu5LbMKECbK_Ao9taYBm-1sf-cu1e7GJxDT-YKKz-OxTnuwyVZvMDr7nj6hun4ShqH1PvOkNA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17eLYxVez1lanRbbQpsAOlqxMkNhHTI2p9OaF18sHsIHrbxbAO8c1EqyVtgKBQqo3Iuq8gwmhB7sc9KPzaGV5yHqKfqyaDA8rhrGH8--wpHx-XMlf3fbcn4r4n-j5RlRCny0jedmD99D5x6mFZhrU2zeLLvFgr4JUEZyT_lXkjslVzIO)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXiz6ciIbDk8IlyLdwVAfLRxOI6EoEhE7l0XcmYa7PH7vFlqosCkItI673pUteWJQ7eeuDTKpd-OrHf1-yD61WwFMTmahrIPBq_WY0YY353RIuCqF__xLf7jlTVRrcudVMFWgzlGlDhEay10qu38At__pySB370ns)Would you like to focus on **immediate relief steps**, **ways to prevent it when drinking** , or **what frequent hangxiety might mean** ? items.title: What Causes It
items.text: Brain chemistry rebound: Alcohol boosts calming GABA and dampens activating glutamate while you drink, then reverses as your body clears it—leaving you more wired and anxious. Dopamine and serotonin drops can also add to the low mood. Poor sleep & dehydration: Alcohol disrupts restorative REM sleep and causes dehydration, which lowers emotional resilience and mimics anxiety symptoms. Psychological & social factors: Worry over impaired judgment or awkward moments can fuel rumination.

items.title: How Long It Lasts
items.text: For most people, hangxiety is strongest the day after drinking and fades within 24 hours. Drinking more alcohol to ease it often prolongs the cycle, while anxiety lasting several days can point to stronger withdrawal or an underlying mental health issue.

items.text: Anyone can get hangxiety, but it is more common in people who already experience anxiety, depression, trauma, or high stress. Shy or introverted individuals, heavy or binge drinkers, and people who drink to cope with social anxiety are also more susceptible.

items.title: Coping & Prevention
items.text: Right now: Rehydrate with water or electrolytes, eat light food, rest, and distract yourself with calm activities or mindfulness. Skip extra alcohol and limit caffeine, which can worsen jitters. For more guidance on calming symptoms, see Cleveland Clinic or Lemonaid Health. Next time: Eat before drinking, pace yourself, alternate drinks with water, set a drink limit, or drink less—and consider talking with a healthcare provider if hangxiety is frequent or tied to relying on alcohol to cope.

items.title: Frequent Hangxiety
items.text: Frequent hangxiety can signal that alcohol is worsening underlying anxiety or mood issues, or that your body is reacting to regular rebound effects. Using alcohol to manage anxiety can create a repetitive cycle; cutting back or speaking with a doctor or therapist can help clarify what is driving it.
